name: History Bowl
shortDescription: A fast-paced buzzer competition testing knowledge across all of history.

overview: History Bowl is a fast-paced academic buzzer competition covering all facets of history, from ancient civilizations to contemporary events. Matches run four rounds: two toss-up rounds of decreasing difficulty (the second with 10-point bonus questions), a rapid-fire "lightning round" against the clock, and a final toss-up round with bonus points for earlier correct answers. Teams field 3–6 players.

participate.whoCanJoin: Open to any Mission San Jose High School student, grades 9–12.
